title: Can Failed Trajectories Reveal Where Agents Go Wrong? Agentic Failure Attribution Without Step-Level Labels
abstract: arXiv:2610.13105v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Failure attribution for LLM agents aims to identify decisive steps responsible for task failure, which is critical for debugging and improving agentic systems. Existing methods rely on costly LLM prompting, step-level error annotations, or verified successful trajectories that lack failure signals for assistance. In this paper, we study failure attribution from step-unlabeled failure trajectories, where each trajectory is known to have failed but its decisive step is unknown. We propose SOAP (Spectral scOring with Attention-guided Propagation), an effective framework requiring neither step-level training labels nor a separate success-only reference set. SOAP first constructs a spectral reference space from LLM representations and assigns each step a base error score according to its projection behavior. translated_title: 失败轨迹能否揭示智能体在何处出错？无需步骤级标签的智能体失败归因
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.13105v1 公告类型：新 摘要：LLM 智能体的失败归因旨在识别导致任务失败的关键步骤，这对于调试和改进智能体系统至关重要。现有方法依赖于成本高昂的 LLM 提示、步骤级错误标注，或缺乏失败信号辅助的已验证成功轨迹。本文研究如何从无步骤标签的失败轨迹中进行失败归因，其中每条轨迹已知已失败，但其关键步骤未知。我们提出了 SOAP（基于注意力引导传播的谱评分，Spectral scOring with Attention-guided Propagation），这是一个有效的框架，既不需要步骤级训练标签，也不需要单独的仅成功参考集。SOAP 首先从 LLM 表示中构建谱参考空间，并根据每一步的投影行为为其分配基础错误分数。重要的是，后续步骤可能表现出更强的失败信号，因为它们继承了较早的错误，这会导致独立评分器失效……
tldr: 提出 SOAP 框架，通过谱评分与注意力引导传播，仅从无步骤标签的失败轨迹中定位 LLM 智能体导致失败的关键步骤，无需人工标注或成功轨迹参考集。
en_tdlr: SOAP enables agentic failure attribution from step-unlabeled failure trajectories via spectral scoring with attention-guided propagation, requiring neither step-level labels nor success-only reference sets.
